title: yunta findings
description: What a review found: one entry per finding.

FindingEntry.description: One finding: where it is, how much it matters, and what goes wrong.

detail.description: What goes wrong, and when: the input or the sequence that shows it.

id.description: Unique among the findings one node reports.

proposed_criterion.description: A command that fails now and passes once the finding is fixed.

title.description: What goes wrong, in one line.

FindingId.description: A finding id: not empty and without control characters

FindingSeverity.description: How much a finding matters, from `blocking` down to `note`.

Location.description: where a finding is: a path relative to the work, with its lines when they are known (`src/lib.rs`, `src/lib.rs:10`, `src/lib.rs:10-14`), or one relative to the run's own directory under the `run:` prefix (`run:objects`). Never absolute

ProposedCriterionEntry.description: A criterion the author proposes to verify the finding's fix.

cmd.description:
The command, run under `sh` on the run's tree; it passes when it
exits 0.
